## Description
Provide a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Quality Gates Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with no warnings/errors.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with no warnings/errors.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Bounded context layers (Presentation -> Platform -> Application -> Domain -> Infrastructure) are respected.
